description: This file defines CLI commands for managing and querying a WebSocket Gateway, including commands for running, inspecting status, discovering gateways via Bonjour, calling RPC methods, and fetching usage and health information.

methods.name: runGatewayCommand
methods.description: Executes a given async action with runtime error handling and logging.

methods.name: parseDaysOption
methods.description: Parses the days option input, defaulting to 30, ensuring a minimum of 1.

methods.name: resolveGatewayRpcOptions
methods.description: Resolves RPC options by inheriting token and password from parent command if not provided.

methods.name: renderCostUsageSummary
methods.description: Formats a usage cost summary into an array of display lines.

methods.name: registerGatewayCli
methods.description: Sets up CLI commands related to the WebSocket Gateway, including run, status, discover, call, health, usage-cost, and probe.
